Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring coordinated communications regarding pathways to college.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to coordinating communications regarding pathwaysto college; and adding a new section to chapter 28A.300 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.300RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The superintendent of public instruction, the higher educationcoordinating board, and the state board for community and technicalcolleges shall jointly compile and disseminate to students, parents,and families information about college pathways, including, but notlimited to, information about minimum entrance eligibility requirementsat each public institution of higher education; general educationcourse requirements and major program course prerequisites; collegeapplication processes and procedures; links to additional sources ofinformation about institution-specific admissions deadlines,requirements, and criteria; and links to information regarding federaland state financial aid programs. The information shall be provided atleast once annually to students, parents, and families beginning whenthe student enters seventh grade and continuing through the twelfthgrade, and shall identify the common school course sequences that p. 1 HB 3074fulfill the minimum college eligibility prerequisites. The informationshall be made available in both paper and electronic formats, anddeveloped so it can be easily updated. (2) School districts and schools shall be the primary conduits ofinformation, and each school district board of directors shall makeprovisions to ensure students, parents, and families are provided theinformation developed under subsection (1) of this section.
